description: Turn an uploaded full mix into a complete DAW session (separated stems as tracks, tempo map, optional per-stem MIDI and chord guide). The result is a downloadable session zip for Logic Pro or Ableton. Async: returns a job_id — poll with doseedo_wait_task (~4 minutes). Cancel: cooperative — the build stops at its next stage boundary and the build's sound-tool unit is refunded (a GPU separation already run stays charged).

audio_key.description: R2 ingest key of an uploaded audio file (from doseedo_get_upload_url / POST /api/upload/r2/ingest-url; starts with "ingest/"). Provide this or audio_url.

audio_url.description: https URL of the audio, as an alternative to audio_key: a doseedo result URL exactly as a job returned it (a stem, a take, a bounce), or any public URL. The gateway fetches it (≤256 MB) into your account's ingest storage before the job starts. Pass audio_key OR audio_url.

chords.description: Add a detected-chords guide track (default false).

crop_silence.description: Punch regions in where each stem plays instead of whole-length stems (default false).

dereverb.description: Opt-in: lay DRY stems and recreate the room with a reverb plugin on each track (default false).

drum_midi_split.description: With "drums" in midi_stems: one Quick Sampler track PER kit piece, each loaded with a synthesized one-shot (default false = one GM drum-roll track).

drum_sampler.description: Sampled kits → a one-shot sampler track + MIDI (default false).

drum_substems.description: Lay each drum piece as its own audio track on a Drums bus (default false; implied by stem_mode drumsep).

guitar_split.description: Split the guitar stem into N players, each its own track + MIDI lane on a Guitar Section bus: "0" (off), "auto" (DEFAULT — a one-vs-two probe decides), "2"–"4".

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

instruments.description: stem_mode orchestra/detect: optional comma list restricting the orchestral set, e.g. "violin,cello,flute".

keep_stem_audio.description: With midi_stems: keep the audio stem next to its MIDI track (default true); false = the MIDI track REPLACES the audio.

key.description: Detect the key and write it into the project (default true in the full build, false with simple).

loops.description: Detect repeated clips and lay them as loops (default false).

markers.description: Add section markers (intro/verse/chorus…) (default true in the full build, false with simple).

midi_stems.description: Optional comma-separated stems to also add as MIDI tracks, e.g. "piano,bass" (include "drums" for a GM drum roll).

name.description: Project name for the session file.

quantize_midi.description: Snap every pitched MIDI lane: "grid" = to the grid its own onsets support (straight/swing 8ths, 16ths, triplets, detected per lane); "score" = notation positions (straight 8ths). Default off (played timing).

retune.description: Default true: a mix sitting >35 cents off A440 is pitch-corrected onto the 12-TET grid before separation (every transcriber coin-flips otherwise). false = leave the tuning as recorded.

separate.description: false = no separation: the mix lands as ONE audio track (default true).

simple.description: Faster minimal build: meter + tempo + stems only, no MIDI (default false). Required for stem_mode orchestra/detect.

stem_mode.description: Separation family. auto (DEFAULT): the 6 stems plus a residual cascade that peels detected orchestral sections out of "other" (no orchestral content → identical to 6stem). 6stem: vocals/drums/bass/guitar/piano/other. drumsep: the drum stem replaced by isolated kick/snare/hh/… tracks on a Drums bus. sections: the 6 stems with "other" split by the joint section model (trumpet/trombone/sax/violin/viola/cello), each transcribed per chair. orchestra / detect: the 53-instrument bank on the MIX (needs simple:true; detect auto-picks, orchestra takes `instruments`).

tempo_map.description: false = one constant tempo instead of a tempo map (default true).

name: doseedo_audio_to_session
